note: Static explainers for Macro Engine pillars, keyed by engine row id. Content: Hercules (COLLAB.md spec, 2026-10-08). Update `live` as conditions change.

policy.title: Policy divergence
policy.body: Central banks moving in different directions. It is the gap between them that moves currencies: money flows toward higher rates.
policy.live: FedWatch Oct ~19%, Dec ~86% — the hawkish hold in week five; RBA minutes (Oct 13) kept the tightening bias alive at 4.60%; CPI Wed 7:30am CT is the test; Fed blackout from Sat Oct 17.

growth.title: Growth differentials
growth.body: Who is accelerating, who is stalling (GDP, jobs, PMIs). Always comparative. Stronger growth pulls in capital and raises hike expectations.
growth.live: US resilient into bank earnings; MUFG says global surprises are 'coming off the boil'; Asia sold off (KOSPI -5.4%, Nikkei -2,000 intraday) on the chip selloff — the growth gaps favor the dollar.

inflation.title: Inflation
inflation.body: CPI/PCE vs the central bank's target. High inflation alone strengthens nothing — what matters is what the bank does about it.
inflation.live: US CPI Wed 7:30am CT (3.6-3.7% y/y, core m/m 0.2%, core y/y 2.5%) — the last big print before FOMC Oct 27-28; China CPI tonight 8:30pm CT; Japan wholesale 6.8% missed (7.6% exp) but stays elevated.

risk.title: Risk sentiment
risk.body: Risk-on vs risk-off. Fear bids USD, JPY, CHF (havens) and sells AUD, NZD, GBP (risk proxies).
risk.live: Asia sold off (KOSPI -5.4%, Nikkei -1.9%) but no safe-haven dash for the dollar — DXY stalled at the 18-month top; fear is expressing through crude, not FX.

tot.title: Terms of trade
tot.body: Export prices vs import prices: oil, metals. The same price moves two currencies opposite ways — say which and why.
tot.live: Brent-WTI ~$12.5-13 still wide — the premium is shipping/geopolitics; WTI ~$92.4-93.3 is the CAD read; Russian diesel deal + OFAC license through Apr 2027 eased product tightness.

positioning.title: Positioning
positioning.body: Where speculators already stand (CFTC COT, Fridays). Crowded trades are fragile: if everyone is long dollars, nobody is left to buy. The contrarian lens — where would a surprise hurt most.
positioning.live: COT w/e Oct 6: EUR/GBP shorts at the ~0th percentile (squeeze risk), AUD shorts at the ~2nd with record gross, yen longs 62,325 at ~86th; USD aggregate longs ~$35.5bn crowded into Wednesday's CPI.

fiscal.title: Fiscal & sovereign risk
fiscal.body: Deficits, debt sustainability, sovereign spreads. Funds stress leaks into the currency.
fiscal.live: France's budget plenary hits the floor 3am CT with OAT-Bund ~134-140 (152bp spike Monday, widest since 2011); German ZEW 4am CT (exp 40.5) reads the growth pulse.
